<style>/* ============================================================
   Kimi游戏榜 — 全站样式
   液态玻璃双方案：本文件为 CSS（backdrop-filter）方案；
   WebGL 方案由 js/glass.js 叠加 canvas 控件层（同一套主题令牌）。
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 主题令牌 ---------- */
:root {
  --accent: #7C3AED;
  --accent-2: #A855F7;
  --accent-ink: #ffffff;

  --bg-1: #eef0f5;
  --bg-2: #e6e9f2;
  --surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, .58);
  --surface-solid: #ffffff;
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .65);
  --border-soft: rgba(20, 20, 40, .08);
  --text: #17171e;
  --text-2: #5c5f6b;
  --text-3: #9aa0ae;

  --glass-blur: 22px;
  --glass-sat: 170%;
  --glass-alpha: .58;
  --radius-lg: 22px;
  --radius-md: 16px;
  --radius-sm: 11px;
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(30, 25, 80, .10);
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(30, 25, 80, .07);

  /* ---------- 皮肤可覆写变量（各皮肤只需覆写这些值） ---------- */
  --tab-active-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent);
  --tab-active-fg: var(--accent);
  --msg-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
  --msg-fg: var(--text);
  --msg-mine-bg: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
  --msg-mine-fg: #ffffff;
  --toast-bg: rgba(24, 24, 32, .92);
  --toast-fg: #ffffff;
  --toast-err-bg: rgba(190, 40, 40, .94);
  --toast-radius: 999px;
  --toast-border: 0;

  --ok: #1a7f37;
  --warn: #d97706;
  --danger: #dc2626;
}

/* iOS 彩色主题：控件分色 */
html[data-accent="ios-colorful"] {
  --accent: #007AFF;
  --accent-2: #34C759;
  --toggle-on: #34C759;
  --slider-fill: #007AFF;
  --cc-a: #FF9500; --cc-b: #34C759; --cc-c: #007AFF; --cc-d: #FF2D55;
}
html[data-accent="blue-purple"] {
  --toggle-on: #7C3AED;
  --slider-fill: #7C3AED;
  --cc-a: #7C3AED; --cc-b: #A855F7; --cc-c: #6366F1; --cc-d: #8B5CF6;
}

/* ---------- 深浅色 ---------- */
html[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-1: #131318;
  --bg-2: #0d0d11;
  --surface: rgba(38, 38, 48, .55);
  --surface-solid: #1e1e26;
  --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
  --border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --text: #f2f2f5;
  --text-2: #b3b6c2;
  --text-3: #7c8194;
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .glass,
html[data-theme="dark"] .topbar,
html[data-theme="dark"] .tabbar { background: var(--surface); }

/* 深浅色切换时背景同步（显式声明，避免继承失效） */
html[data-theme="light"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 12% -8%, rgba(109, 59, 245, .18), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 620px at 92% 6%, rgba(80, 120, 255, .14), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, var(--bg-1), var(--bg-2) 70%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 12% -8%, rgba(109, 59, 245, .22), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 620px at 92% 6%, rgba(40, 70, 180, .18), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, var(--bg-1), var(--bg-2) 70%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

/* ---------- 基础 ---------- */
* { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
/* 关键：display:flex/grid 等作者样式会覆盖 [hidden] 的 UA 规则，
   必须全局强制，否则搜索面板/遮罩/公告条会常显 */
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }   /* 禁止整页滚动，改为应用内滚动 */
body {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text);
  font: 15px/1.55 'MiSans VF', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 12% -8%, rgba(124, 58, 237, .20), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 620px at 92% 6%, rgba(80, 120, 255, .16), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, var(--bg-1), var(--bg-2) 70%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
input, textarea { font: inherit; color: var(--text); }
::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent); }

/* 视觉隐藏的原生控件（soul：禁原生控件，一律自绘） */
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }

/* ---------- 玻璃基类 ---------- */
.glass {
  background: var(--surface);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-sat));
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-sat));
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .55), var(--shadow-sm);
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .glass {
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .10), var(--shadow);
}
/* 不支持 backdrop-filter 的浏览器：磨砂兜底 */
@supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {
  .glass { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-solid) 92%, transparent); }
}

/* ---------- 布局 ---------- */
#app {
  position: relative; z-index: 10;
  height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.announce {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
  margin: 10px 12px 0; padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
  color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 13px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* 搜索态提示 */

}

/* ============================================================
 * 搜索结果页顶部：AI 总结卡片

 * ============================================================ */
.ai-sum {
  padding: 13px 14px 4px; margin-bottom: 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

  display: grid; place-items: center;

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
}
.ai-sum-title {
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text);

.ai-sum-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--text-2); }

.ai-sum.collapsed .ai-sum-body {
  max-height: 158px; overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 66%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 66%, transparent);
}
.ai-sum-toggle {
  display: block; width: 100%; padding: 9px 0 11px;
  border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--accent); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit;
}

/* 加载态：三点脉冲（与按钮加载态同一语言，不用旋转器） */
.ai-sum-loading { display: flex; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 0 13px; }
.ai-sum-loading i {
  width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-3);
  animation: ai-sum-pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.ai-sum-loading i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .16s; }
.ai-sum-loading i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .32s; }

  50%      { opacity: 1;   transform: translateY(-2px); }
}

}

}

@keyframes vtFwdIn  { from { transform: translate3d(22%,0,0);  opacity: .3  } to { transform: none; opacity: 1 } }
@keyframes vtFwdOut { from { transform: none; opacity: 1 } to { transform: translate3d(-12%,0,0); opacity: .4 } }
@keyframes vtBackIn { from { transform: translate3d(-12%,0,0); opacity: .4 } to { transform: none; opacity: 1 } }
@keyframes vtBackOut{ from { transform: none; opacity: 1 } to { transform: translate3d(22%,0,0);  opacity: .3 } }

::view-transition-old(root),
::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .3s;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.22,.85,.25,1);
  animation-fill-mode: both;
}
html[data-nav-dir="fwd"]::view-transition-old(root)  { animation-name: vtFwdOut; }
html[data-nav-dir="fwd"]::view-transition-new(root)  { animation-name: vtFwdIn; }
html[data-nav-dir="back"]::view-transition-old(root) { animation-name: vtBackOut; }
html[data-nav-dir="back"]::view-transition-new(root) { animation-name: vtBackIn; }

/* ---- 各风格转场节奏（同一动作，不同性格）---- */
html[data-skin="md3"]::view-transition-old(root),
html[data-skin="md3"]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .34s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.05,.7,.1,1);
}
html[data-skin="pixel"]::view-transition-old(root),
html[data-skin="pixel"]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .24s; animation-timing-function: steps(5, end);
}
html[data-skin="sketch"]::view-transition-old(root),
html[data-skin="sketch"]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .36s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.34,1.2,.4,1);
}
html[data-skin="brutal"]::view-transition-old(root),
html[data-skin="brutal"]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .18s; animation-timing-function: steps(3, end);
}
html[data-skin="glass"]::view-transition-old(root),
html[data-skin="glass"]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation-duration: .32s;
}

/* ---- 预见式返回：跟手时把上一页铺在当前页身后 ---- */
.back-preview {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none;
  background: var(--bg);
  transform-origin: left center;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}
.back-preview > * { min-height: 100%; }
/* 内容层压住预览层；刻意不设背景色——跟手位移时露出的应当是平时那层底色，
   否则会出现「白底一闪」，也会盖掉各风格铺在 body 上的纹理 */
#view { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

/* 共享元素 morph：封面在列表项与详情页之间沿同一几何轨迹过渡 */
::view-transition-group(hero) {
  animation-duration: .34s;
  animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.22,.85,.25,1);
}
html[data-skin="pixel"]::view-transition-group(hero) { animation-timing-function: steps(5, end); }
html[data-skin="brutal"]::view-transition-group(hero) { animation-duration: .2s; }
html[data-skin="sketch"]::view-transition-group(hero) { animation-duration: .4s; animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.34,1.2,.4,1); }

/* 表情分组标签（表情数量多，按包切换） */
.pk-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0 2px 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.pk-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 0; }
.pk-tab { flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); background: transparent; color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }
.pk-tab.on { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; }
.pk-tab .pk-n { margin-left: 5px; font-size: 11px; opacity: .6; }

/* ---------- 反馈页：输入区与列表区需要明确分层 ---------- */
/* 此前两块都是同一层级的卡片，视觉上连成一片，看不出哪里是「填」、哪里是「看」 */
.fb-list-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  margin: 20px 4px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-2); letter-spacing: .2px;
}
.fb-list-head::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border-soft); }
#fbList > .card { margin-bottom: 10px; }
#fbList > .card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
/* 列表里的卡片层级略低于输入卡片，避免两张「同重量」的卡直接相邻 */
#fbList .card { box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

/* ---------- 违纪通报 ---------- */
.violation-hero { padding: 18px 16px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 30%, transparent); }
.violation-hero h2 { margin: 8px 0 6px; }
.vh-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em;
  padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--danger);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 40%, transparent); margin: 0; }
.disc-reasons { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; }
.disc-reasons li { margin: 4px 0; }
.disc-item { cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.disc-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

/* 违纪通报 · 表单选项（自绘，不用原生 checkbox） */
.disc-pick { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 2px; }
.disc-opt { font: inherit; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 22%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 4%, transparent); }
.disc-opt.on { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); }

/* 违纪通报 · 键值表（封禁信息） */
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 6px 14px; margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }
.kv dt { color: var(--text-2, var(--muted)); white-space: nowrap; }
.kv dd { margin: 0; }

/* 被通报用户的标记：比身份徽章更醒目，用于提醒其他读者 */
.badge-violation { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 600;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 42%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent); }

/* ---------- 控制面板 · 社区凭证「扫码填写」 ---------- */
.tok-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.tok-row .input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.tok-row .btn-ghost { flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }
.btn-ghost.is-open { color: var(--accent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); }
#tokQR[hidden] { display: none; }
.qr-wrap { text-align: center; margin: 12px 0 6px; }
.qr-box { width: 188px; height: 188px; margin: 0 auto 10px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; }
.qr-box svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.qr-hint { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); min-height: 18px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.qr-hint.ok { color: #0a8a3c; }
.qr-hint.bad { color: var(--danger); }
.qr-hint.wait { color: var(--accent); }

/* ---------- 榜单：手动加载 + 返回定位高亮 ---------- */
.rank-more { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 0 6px; }
.rank-more .btn { min-width: 148px; }
.rank-more .tiny { text-align: center; }
.rank-item.rank-flash {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 58%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent), var(--shadow-sm);
  animation: rankFlash 1.6s ease-out 1;
}
@keyframes rankFlash {
  0%   { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, var(--surface)); }
  60%  { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, var(--surface)); }
  100% { background: var(--surface); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .rank-item.rank-flash { animation: none; }
}


/* ---------- 全站对象编号（oid） ---------- */
.oid {
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .3px;
  color: inherit;
  opacity: .55;
  background: rgba(128, 128, 128, .14);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  vertical-align: middle;
  user-select: text;
  -webkit-user-select: text;
}


/* ---------- 网页异常监测（跟随站点主题、配色与皮肤） ---------- */
.mon-app { --mbg:var(--bg-1); --mfg:var(--text); --mmut:var(--text-2); --mline:var(--border-soft);
  --mcard:var(--surface-solid); --macc:var(--accent); --msoft:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  --mok:#15803d; --mwarn:#b45309; --mbad:#c02626;
  padding:16px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--mbg); color:var(--mfg); }
html[data-theme="dark"] .mon-app { --mok:#4ade80; --mwarn:#fbbf24; --mbad:#f87171; }
.mon-app *, .mon-app *::before, .mon-app *::after { box-sizing:border-box; }

/* 顶部 */
.mon-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:12px; }
.mon-title { position:relative; font-size:21px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.2px; padding-left:13px; color:var(--mfg); }
.mon-title::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:3px; bottom:3px; width:4px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--macc); }
.mon-top-r { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

/* 分段器 */
.mon-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:3px; border:1px solid var(--mline); border-radius:11px; background:var(--mcard); }
.mon-seg button { border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--mmut); font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
  padding:6px 13px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease, color .16s ease; }
.mon-seg button:hover { color:var(--mfg); background:var(--msoft); }
.mon-seg button.on { background:var(--macc); color:var(--accent-ink); }
.mon-tabs { margin-bottom:12px; max-width:100%; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:thin; flex-wrap:nowrap; }
.mon-tabs button { white-space:nowrap; }

/* 健康总览条 */
.mon-health { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:12px; padding:11px 14px;
  border:1px solid var(--mline); border-left-width:4px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--mcard);
  font-size:13.5px; color:var(--mfg); }
.mon-health.ok   { border-left-color:var(--mok);   background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mok) 9%, var(--mcard)); }
.mon-health.warn { border-left-color:var(--mwarn); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mwarn) 11%, var(--mcard)); }
.mon-health.bad  { border-left-color:var(--mbad);  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mbad) 11%, var(--mcard)); }
.mon-health b { font-weight:800; }
.mon-health.ok b   { color:var(--mok); }
.mon-health.warn b { color:var(--mwarn); }
.mon-health.bad b  { color:var(--mbad); }
.mon-health .mh-dot { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; flex:0 0 auto; }
.mon-health.ok .mh-dot   { color:var(--mok); }
.mon-health.warn .mh-dot { color:var(--mwarn); }
.mon-health.bad .mh-dot  { color:var(--mbad); }
.mon-health .mh-txt { color:var(--mmut); }
.mon-health .mh-txt i { font-style:normal; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.mon-health .mh-txt .mh-bad { color:var(--mbad); font-weight:800; }
.mon-health .mh-txt .mh-warn { color:var(--mwarn); font-weight:800; }

/* 指标分组 */
.mon-kgroup { margin-bottom:12px; }
.mon-kgroup-t { font-size:12.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.4px; color:var(--mfg); opacity:.78; margin:0 0 7px 2px; }
.mon-kpis { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(152px,1fr)); gap:9px; }
.mon-kpi { position:relative; border:1px solid var(--mline); background:var(--mcard); border-radius:12px;
  padding:11px 13px 11px 15px; overflow:hidden; }
.mon-kpi::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:3px; background:var(--mline); }
.mon-kpi .mk-v { font-size:23px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.1px; line-height:1.12; color:var(--mfg);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.mon-kpi .mk-l { font-size:12.5px; color:var(--mmut); margin-top:4px; }
.mon-kpi.mk-ok::before   { background:var(--mok); }
.mon-kpi.mk-ok   .mk-v { color:var(--mok); }
.mon-kpi.mk-warn::before { background:var(--mwarn); }
.mon-kpi.mk-warn .mk-v { color:var(--mwarn); }
.mon-kpi.mk-bad::before  { background:var(--mbad); }
.mon-kpi.mk-bad  .mk-v { color:var(--mbad); }

/* 卡片 / 列表 */
.mon-cards { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(252px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
.mon-card { border:1px solid var(--mline); background:var(--mcard); border-radius:12px; padding:13px 15px; margin-bottom:12px; }
.mon-card-t { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:9px; color:var(--mfg); }
.mon-card-t::before { content:''; width:3px; height:13px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--macc); }
.mon-ul { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; }
.mon-ul li { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:6px 7px; margin:0 -7px;
  font-size:13px; border-radius:7px; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mline) 70%, transparent); }
.mon-ul li:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.mon-ul li:hover { background:var(--msoft); }
.mon-ul .mon-li-n { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--mmut); min-width:0; }
.mon-ul li b { flex:0 0 auto; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--mfg); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.mon-trend { width:100%; height:120px; display:block; margin:4px 0 6px; }
.mon-grid { stroke:var(--mline); stroke-width:1; stroke-dasharray:3 4; }
.mon-peak { fill:var(--macc); }
.mon-sub { display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:12px; color:var(--mmut); }
.mon-sub b { color:var(--mfg); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.mon-ell { max-width:340px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

/* 表格 */
.mon-app .table { width:100%; border-collapse:separate; border-spacing:0; font-size:13px; }
.mon-app .table th, .mon-app .table td { padding:8px 11px; text-align:left; vertical-align:middle;
  border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mline) 70%, transparent); }
.mon-app .table th { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:1; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--macc) 12%, var(--mcard));
  color:var(--mfg); font-weight:800; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.3px; white-space:nowrap; }
/* 行级定位：整行含任一异常值 → 淡红底，一眼锁定最差的接口 */
.mon-app .table tbody tr:has(.mon-bad) td { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mbad) 10%, transparent); }
.mon-app .table tbody tr:has(.mon-bad):hover td { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mbad) 16%, transparent); }
.mon-app .table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mline) 26%, transparent); }
.mon-app .table tbody tr:hover td { background:var(--msoft); }
.mon-app .table td.mon-n { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; }
.mon-app .table td.mon-t { color:var(--mmut); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; }

.mon-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:8px 0; font-size:13px;
  border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mline) 65%, transparent); }
.mon-input { border:1px solid var(--mline); background:var(--mcard); color:var(--mfg); border-radius:9px;
  padding:7px 11px; font:inherit; font-size:13px; max-width:130px; transition:border-color .16s ease; }
.mon-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:var(--macc); }
.mon-actions { display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.mon-btn { border:0; background:var(--macc); color:var(--accent-ink); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 17px;
  font:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .16s ease, transform .12s ease; }
.mon-btn:hover { filter:brightness(1.07); }
.mon-btn:active { transform:scale(.985); }
.mon-btn.ghost { background:transparent; color:var(--mfg); border:1px solid var(--mline); }
.mon-btn.ghost:hover { border-color:var(--macc); color:var(--macc); }
@media (max-width:560px) {
  .mon-kpis { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
  .mon-cards { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
}

/* ---------- 文字溢出兜底：长链接 / 长编号 / 长用户名不撑破容器 ---------- */
.table th, .table td, .kv dd, .rank-meta, .who, .disc-item, .bubble, .card, .chip, .badge,
.drawer-item span, .mon-ul li, .mon-kpi .mk-v { word-break:break-word; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.kv dd, .rank-meta, .who, .disc-item, .bubble, .mon-ul li, .mon-tl li { min-width:0; }
.disc-reasons li, .kv dt, .tiny { word-break:break-word; }
.mon-sk { height:140px; border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg, var(--msoft) 20%, var(--mcard) 45%, var(--msoft) 70%);
  background-size:200% 100%; animation:monShimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes monShimmer { 0% { background-position:120% 0; } 100% { background-position:-80% 0; } }
.mon-empty { color:var(--mmut); font-size:13px; padding:22px 0; text-align:center; }
.mon-click { cursor:pointer; }
.mon-bad { color:var(--mbad); font-weight:800; }
.mon-warnv { color:var(--mwarn); font-weight:800; }
.mon-track { color:var(--macc); font-weight:800; }
.mon-unacked td { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mbad) 12%, transparent) !important; }
.mon-tl { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; }
.mon-tl li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:78px 52px 1fr 2fr; gap:10px; align-items:baseline;
  padding:7px; margin:0 -7px; font-size:13px; border-radius:7px;
  border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mline) 60%, transparent); }
.mon-tl li:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.mon-tl li:hover { background:var(--msoft); }
.mon-tl .mon-tl-t { color:var(--mmut); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.mon-tl .mon-tl-k { color:var(--macc); font-weight:700; }
.mon-tl .mon-tl-n { min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.mon-tl .mon-tl-m { color:var(--mmut); min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
/* 宽表在窄容器内横向滚动，避免内容被挤出卡片（此前溢出、右侧列看不到） */
.mon-scroll { overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; }
.mon-scroll .table { min-width:640px; }
.mon-mut { color:var(--mmut); font-size:12px; margin-left:4px; }
.mon-moreline { text-align:center; color:var(--mmut); padding:12px 0 4px; }
.mon-sess-meta { font-size:12.5px; color:var(--mmut); margin:-2px 0 10px; }
.mon-sess-meta b { color:var(--mfg); font-weight:700; }
.mon-tl li.lvl-error .mon-tl-k { color:var(--mbad); }
.mon-tl li.lvl-warn .mon-tl-k  { color:var(--mwarn); }

/* ---------- 宣传视频（关于页 / 注册页） ---------- */
.video-embed { position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#000; overflow:hidden;
  margin:6px 0 10px; border-radius:var(--radius-sm); }
.video-embed iframe { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0; }
.reg-video { margin-top:16px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.reg-video-btn { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; padding:10px 12px;
  background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  color:var(--text-2); font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; text-align:left;
  transition:border-color .15s, color .15s; }
.reg-video-btn:hover { color:var(--text); border-color:var(--accent); }
.reg-video-btn .ic { width:16px; height:16px; fill:currentColor; flex:none; }
.reg-video-frame:not(:empty) { position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#000;
  overflow:hidden; border-radius:var(--radius-sm); }
.reg-video-frame iframe { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0; }

/* ---------- 提交作品页 ---------- */
.req { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
.sb-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-top:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.sb-qr { margin-top:12px; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.sb-qr[hidden] { display:none; }
.sb-qr-img { width:168px; height:168px; background:#fff; border-radius:6px; display:flex;
